name: HeroUI v3 Implementation Patterns

patterns.principle: Build interactive semantics on established accessibility primitives rather than styling raw divs into controls.
patterns.vaultUse: Prefer React Aria/HeroUI for keyboard, focus, selection and overlay semantics in compatible React builds.

patterns.principle: Keep component behavior in React and visual variants in a separate style package.
patterns.vaultUse: Allows one accessible primitive to adopt radically different domain-specific Vault themes without rewriting interaction logic.

patterns.principle: Expose meaningful composition pieces such as root, trigger, backdrop, container, dialog, header, body, footer and close trigger.
patterns.vaultUse: Prefer semantic subcomponents over giant prop surfaces when complex structures need layout flexibility.

patterns.principle: Group context can provide defaults while direct child props override them.
patterns.vaultUse: Useful for button groups, selection groups, toolbars and other coordinated controls.

patterns.principle: Support controlled open state and onOpenChange while keeping trigger/dialog composition accessible.
patterns.vaultUse: Apply to modal, drawer, popover and menu patterns that need application-level state orchestration.

patterns.principle: Use stable semantic slot markers for styling and composition boundaries.
patterns.vaultUse: Data-slot conventions can improve maintainability and visual QA targeting without coupling to brand class names.

patterns.principle: Compose visual classes with interaction render state instead of duplicating behavioral logic.
patterns.vaultUse: Keep hover/pressed/focus/open/selected styling aligned with the primitive's actual state.

patterns.principle: Treat overlay placement, scrolling and sizing as explicit behavior rather than incidental CSS.
patterns.vaultUse: Modal/drawer behavior should intentionally transform for mobile instead of merely shrinking desktop UI.

patterns.principle: Interactive primitives should expose disabled, invalid, selected, open, loading, empty and focus-visible states where meaningful.
patterns.vaultUse: Use HeroUI state behavior as a floor, then add product/domain-specific loading, recovery and permission states.

originalityRule: These are transferable engineering principles. Do not copy HeroUI branding or force its default visual expression into unrelated products.
